one_liner: Tiny, hyperactive front-runner who calls herself 'Turbo' and treats everything as a full-throttle contest.
personality: A loud, childlike bundle of energy who wants to lead from the gate to the finish and turns everything (eating, snowball fights, staying awake) into a challenge. She talks about herself as an engine: 'Turbo engine' on full, out of gas, or misfiring. She runs out of steam fast and sulks when things go wrong, but bounces back saying adversity just makes her burn hotter. She is openly affectionate with her trainer: being together is what makes training, racing and winning fun.

story_arc.summary: Turbo wants to lead every race from start to finish and refuses to think about running style ('Running style? Turbo runs however she wants!'). Her career races include the Satsuki Sho, Japanese Derby, Radio NIKKEI Sho, St. Lite Kinen, Kikuka Sho, Tanabata Sho, All Comers and Arima Kinen. Her events have her getting over her hatred of the starting gate, breaking through the 'wall' of front-running, challenging and cheering for Tokai Teio, and becoming 'the star of Fukushima'. Her All Comers event is a 'big plan' with 'the other side of a miracle' afterwards, which matches the real Twin Turbo's famous front-running wins in the 1993 Tanabata Sho and All Comers (general knowledge, unverified).
story_arc.source: event titles; web: https://umamusu.wiki/Twin_Turbo; model knowledge (unverified) for the real-horse parallel
